outlet: Journal of the San Juan Islands, 'Election 2026 County Council Candidate Profiles', Kristina Stucki, July 27, 2026
notes: Profiles of Bryant Ingman, Koplan and Swanson. Bryant Ingman: disappointed the county levy lid lift failed; wants listening sessions before any return to the ballot; voted for the Lopez rec levy; emphasizes generational perspective. Swanson: only candidate with elected experience with public funds; 'we can't keep going with the status quo because we can't afford it'; 'the longest track record and ... most experienced, seasoned candidate'.
